<span class="origin-badge origin-badge--onesimus">Onesimus extension</span>

Job chain of a client's latest state (restore option 5).

## Synopsis

```text
.ovfs_latest client=<client> [fileset=<fileset>] [json]
```

Words without brackets are required, `[ ]` marks optional parts, `a | b` alternatives, `...` a repeatable argument and `[,...]` a comma separated list.

## Description

Onesimus extension: determines the job chain for the newest state of a client, as restore menu item 5 selects it: the last Full backup of the fileset, the last Differential after it and all Incrementals after Full or Differential. Only backups with status T or W count, Differentials and Incrementals only if they are on an enabled volume. fileset= is needed when the client has backups of several filesets.

Pass the comma separated list as jobid= to .ovfs\_tree and .ovfs\_ls, so the tree stays the same while browsing even if a new backup finishes. json prints the result as one JSON line.

## Arguments {#arguments}

| Argument | Type | Values / source | Default | Flags | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `client=` | resource | from [`.clients`](../dot-clients/) |  | required | Client name. |
| `fileset=` | resource | from [`.filesets`](../dot-filesets/) |  |  | FileSet name. |
| `json` | keyword |  |  |  | Print the JSON object as text. |

## Examples

The newest job chain of a client:

```text
.ovfs_latest client=bareos-fd
```

The chain of one fileset as JSON:

```text
.ovfs_latest client=bareos-fd fileset=LinuxAll json
```
